name: Livestock, Domestication, Feeding, Breeding & Animal Products Runtime
design_rules: livestock consume explicit feed and water rather than abstract upkeep
domestication increases gradually through repeated safe care
animal health responds to feeding hydration shelter and disease pressure
breeding requires sufficient health tameness and mature partners
animal products depend on species condition and care
slaughter products are not generated without removing an animal
manure can return fertility to agriculture
livestock state persists across world days
livestock never uses emissive or glow feedback
